motion_rule: HE crosses the frame edge to edge in EVERY beat, talking ones too, the walls streaking past behind HIM; HE fills at least half the frame height, the camera riding level with HIM; a new shot size and one impulse per beat; never a held pose or a prop worked in place
character: a plump velvet mole in BLACK ROUND GLASSES, huge pink shovel-paws, dusty, dead serious
second_characters: ONE digger above, faceless, only a SHOVEL blade through the roof
props: CALCULATOR: cream plastic, BLANK buttons and screen. CHEST: battered trunk, cracked MIRROR nailed inside the lid. BOOTS: two, split. HAT: crushed felt. BROOM: a torn bundle of roots. TAPER STAND: old brass, lit wick, a prop not the light
prop_continuity: the calculator is only carried, hurled and swung; the broom is ripped from the wall at 5.4 and flung off by 7.2; the glasses stay on; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a long burrow tunnel, roots and stones, a brass stand ahead
lighting: bright light from holes above, dust motes, high exposure

audio.language: Russian, verbatim, each word said once; latin hints not spoken
audio.delivery: calm businesslike male voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec, first word on frame one; last word flat and dejected
audio.pacing: speech 0.0-2.8 and 3.5-5.9; pause 2.8-3.5; voiceless 5.9-8.6 and after 9.1, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: paws in soil, an iron chime under the floor from 2.8, the burrow ringing by 5.9, the lid at 6.5, boots at 7.2, brass toppling at 9.1
audio.music: none until 6.5, then a soft music box

timeline.a: HE bolts left to right down the tunnel, calculator in one paw, roots and stones streaking past
HE hurls the calculator ahead and dives right to left after it, the wall streaking
HE scoops the calculator off the floor on the run, left to right, soil at the lens
HE swings the calculator like a shovel and slings right to left, soil peeling off the wall
the SHOVEL stabs through the roof at HIS head, HE hurls himself edge to edge clear, earth blasting
the shovel rips out and the wall with it, HE rides the falling soil left to right
HE swings up a root and whips right to left, the tunnel streaking under HIM
HE loses the root and skids left to right on HIS belly, ear to the ground
HE slams the far wall and rebounds right to left, a root broom tearing out in HIS paw
HE sweeps a wall of dust ahead with the broom, driving left to right, soil flying off HIS paws, the chest breaking out under HIM
the lid bangs up, mirror swinging, HE skids past right to left and flings the broom off at the boots
tight on HIS legs, HE stamps one foot then the other into the boots on the run, driving left to right
HE jams the hat down with both paws and struts right to left past the mirror, chest out
HE swings around left to right at the mirror, sees the boots and hat on himself, HIS shoulders drop, the brim over HIS glasses
HIS boot clips the brass stand, it topples, HE trudges straight AT the lens, filling the frame

must_appear: shovel down at 2.8, the broom out of the wall at 5.4, boots and hat inside, the mirror in the open lid, boots on at 7.2, hat on at 7.9
negative_prompt: cyrillic, subtitles, a repeated or stuttered word, any word after 9.1, a lit calculator screen, a paw pressing buttons, night, slow speech, a still wall behind him, a wide or distant hero, a hero on his back, a broom worked in place
